component.name: RelayTV
component.summary: Local-first TV playback and automation endpoint

description.p: RelayTV turns a Linux box plugged into a TV into a local-first playback appliance: a web UI and HTTP API drive fullscreen mpv playback of YouTube, Jellyfin/Emby, and direct media URLs, with queueing, HDMI-CEC TV control, and mDNS discovery on the local network.
